decisions: Deployment Feasibility: Can we consolidate our audio stack into Qwen2-Audio?

requirements.description: Will this model fit on our standard inference GPUs (e.g., 24GB VRAM), or is it too big?
Is the latency low enough for a conversation, or is there a noticeable lag before it starts responding?
Is there a hard limit on audio length (like 30 seconds) that would break our use case for long files?
How does it handle noisy audio or background chatter? Does it fail or just transcribe the noise?
Does it refuse to process certain audio types (safety refusals) that might be false positives for us?
Can we swap out the audio encoder part later, or is it tightly coupled to the Qwen text model?
